title: Driving travel time from the Natural History Building to the UIUC campus network
output_type: image (network nodes coloured by travel time)
method: Load the frozen OSM drive network (osmnx.load_graphml, 240 nodes / 709 edges, 1 km around 1301 W Green St); osmnx add_edge_speeds + add_edge_travel_times; origin = nearest node to the Natural History Building (40.10944, -88.22625); Dijkstra on 'travel_time' (s) on the directed graph; store as node attribute; plot nodes coloured by time.

key_parameters.impedance: travel_time (s) from osmnx imputed speeds (maxspeed 25/30 mph where tagged)
key_parameters.reachable_nodes: 239 of 240 (one node unreachable on the directed graph)

benchmark_defects: The task requires retrieving data from OSM, impossible offline; a frozen GraphML snapshot of the network is supplied instead.
The NHB coordinates are not in the task text; without a geocoder agents must use the snapshot centre (~130 m away) or prior knowledge - checks allow 400 m.
With the snapshot, the authors' get_node_colors_by_attr + plot_graph pattern crashes because one node is unreachable (NaN attribute); agents must handle unreachable nodes.
checks: required: a per-node vector (graph attributes, dict/series, node table, or scatter values at node positions) with Pearson >= 0.90 vs the reference field: the gold pipeline run from the solution's own origin node when that origin is within 400 m of the NHB, else the gold-origin field
required: median ratio to the reference field 0.67-1.5 in seconds or minutes
required: minimum-value (origin) node within 400 m of the NHB
required: network routing: Pearson with osmnx travel-time Dijkstra from the solution's own origin >= 0.97 and > Pearson with straight-line distance + 0.01
required: speeds derived from the graph: Pearson with length-Dijkstra (directed or undirected) from the own origin < 0.999
required: a drawn point collection at node positions carries values or colormap colours with |Spearman| >= 0.90 vs the reference field
